sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.email FROM customer AS c JOIN address AS a ON a.address_id = c.address_id JOIN city AS ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id WHERE ci.city = 'London'
SELECT f.film_id, f.title FROM film AS f WHERE f.length BETWEEN 90 AND 110 ORDER BY f.replacement_cost ASC, f.film_id ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(p.payment_date, '%Y-%m') AS payment_month, COUNT(*) AS payment_events FROM payment AS p GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(p.payment_date, '%Y-%m')
SELECT c.store_id, ROUND(AVG(p.amount), 4) AS average_payment_amount FROM customer AS c JOIN payment AS p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.store_id

SELECT a.actor_id, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS g_film_titles FROM actor AS a LEFT JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id LEFT JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = fa.film_id AND f.rating = 'G' GROUP BY a.actor_id ORDER BY g_film_titles ASC, a.actor_id ASC
SELECT i.store_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.film_id) AS distinct_film_titles, COUNT(*) AS inventory_copies FROM inventory AS i GROUP BY i.store_id
SELECT COUNT(*) AS unavailable_copies FROM inventory AS i WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rental AS r WHERE r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id AND r.return_date IS NULL)

SELECT i.store_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.film_id) AS available_film_titles FROM inventory AS i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rental AS r WHERE r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id AND r.return_date IS NULL) GROUP BY i.store_id

SELECT SUM(eligible.month_total) AS qualifying_payment_total FROM (SELECT p.customer_id, SUM(p.amount) AS month_total FROM payment AS p WHERE p.payment_date >= '2005-08-01 00:00:00' AND p.payment_date < '2005-09-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY p.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 AND SUM(p.amount) > 15.00) AS eligible

SELECT COUNT(*) AS eligible_home_store_customers FROM customer AS c WHERE c.store_id = 1 AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT p.customer_id FROM payment AS p WHERE p.payment_date >= '2005-08-01 00:00:00' AND p.payment_date < '2005-09-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY p.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 AND SUM(p.amount) > 15.00)

SELECT f.film_id, f.title FROM film AS f JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE r.rental_date <= '2005-07-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(CAST(DATEDIFF(r.return_date, r.rental_date) AS SIGNED) - CAST(f.rental_duration AS SIGNED), 0) END) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(CAST(DATEDIFF(r.return_date, r.rental_date) AS SIGNED) - CAST(f.rental_duration AS SIGNED), 0) END) DESC, f.film_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN r.return_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(CAST(DATEDIFF(r.return_date, r.rental_date) AS SIGNED) - CAST(f.rental_duration AS SIGNED), 0) END) AS largest_single_rental_late_component FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id WHERE r.rental_date <= '2005-07-01 00:00:00'
